title: ACA s. 31 — Form and contents of arbitral award (ACA s. 31)

content.overview: Section 31 regulates the form and contents of an arbitral award, including writing, signature, reasons subject to statutory exceptions, date and place, delivery of a signed copy to each party, and statutory provisions concerning interest and costs.

content.study:
Section 31 — Form and contents of arbitral award

Section 31 regulates the form and contents of an arbitral award, including writing, signature, reasons subject to statutory exceptions, date and place, delivery of a signed copy to each party, and statutory provisions concerning interest and costs.

Apply the provision by identifying operative conditions, exceptions, procedural stage and connected provisions. Do not substitute generic arbitration practice for the statutory rule.
